title: Make your first donut
goal: Model a donut and give it a realistic golden-brown material

milestones.goal: Start from an empty scene: delete every mesh object
milestones.done_when: No mesh object is left: the outliner lists only the Camera and the Light (no Cube, Cone or other mesh) and the viewport shows no object
hints: Click a mesh in the viewport or the outliner to select it
Repeat for each mesh (or press A to select all, then X)
milestones.teach: Every new Blender scene starts with a cube, a camera and a light; we start clean for the donut.

milestones.done_when: A ring-shaped object is in the viewport and 'Torus' is listed in the outliner
hints: Add menu in the top bar of the viewport
Hover Mesh: its submenu opens without clicking
milestones.teach: A torus is a ready-made ring mesh: the perfect starting shape for a donut.

milestones.goal: Smooth the donut with a Subdivision Surface modifier
milestones.done_when: The Modifier properties tab shows a Subdivision modifier on the Torus
hints: Properties panel on the right: wrench icon (Modifier Properties)
milestones.teach: Subdivision adds geometry and rounds the shape without changing the model you edit.

milestones.goal: Create a new material for the torus
milestones.done_when: The Material properties tab shows a material slot with a Principled BSDF surface
hints: Properties panel: red sphere icon (Material Properties)

milestones.goal: Make the base color golden brown
milestones.done_when: The Base Color swatch of the material is a warm golden-brown and the donut looks brown in the viewport
hints: Pick an orange-brown in the color wheel and lower the brightness
milestones.teach: Base Color is the surface's own color before lighting and reflections.
